name: Bottom sheet
summary: A panel that slides up from the bottom edge on phones. It holds menus, short forms and details without leaving the screen.

anatomy.purpose: Dims the screen behind a modal sheet. Tap closes it.
The panel. Rounded top corners, anchored to the bottom edge, respects the safe area.
Short bar that shows the sheet can be dragged. Must also have a non-drag way to close.
A list of actions, a short form, or details. Scrolls inside the sheet.
Sticky footer with one primary action.

variants.name: Action list
variants.use: Choose one of 2 to 6 actions, such as share, edit, delete.

contentLimits.title: max 40 characters
contentLimits.content: 2 to 6 rows, one line each, 48px minimum height per row
contentLimits.actions: none; a cancel row at the end

variants.name: Short form
variants.use: Collect 1 to 3 inputs, such as a filter or a note.

variants.name: Expandable details
variants.use: Show a summary that expands to full detail, such as a map result or an order.

contentLimits.title: max 40 characters
contentLimits.content: summary in the peek state; full content when expanded

whenToUse: On phones, anywhere a desktop would use a modal or popover.
Choosing from a short list of actions.
Showing details of an item while keeping the list visible behind it.
whenNotToUse: On desktop widths: use a modal, popover or drawer instead.
Long or multi-step flows: use a full screen.
Critical confirmations that must not be dismissed by a drag: use a modal dialog.

keyboard: Escape closes it when a keyboard is present.
Tab cycles focus inside a modal sheet.
accessibility.focus: Move focus to the title or first control on open; return it to the trigger on close.
notes: Dragging must never be the only way to close or expand: provide a close button or cancel row.
Touch targets are at least 44x44px (WCAG 2.2 requires 24x24 minimum; 44 is the platform guidance).
Respect the bottom safe area so actions are not hidden by the home indicator.
